title: Jazzy Holidays at Jollywood Nights | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Jazzy Holidays at The Hollywood Brown Derby Located in Hollywood Boulevard at Disney's Hollywood Studios Celebrate the season with festive flavors and live music during Disney Jollywood Nights, on select nights from November 7, 2026, through January 5, 2027. Dining Events Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. Advance reservations are highly encouraged. Check back in late September for information on how to make a reservation.Smooth Sounds & Flavorful FareSip craft cocktails and indulge in an event-exclusive menu of light bites while a pianist plays smooth holiday tunes during Jazzy Holidays at The Hollywood Brown Derby.This jazzy holiday experience is available only during Disney Jollywood Nights—a separate-ticket event at Disney’s Hollywood Studios held select nights during the holiday season. Check back in late September for more details about this special holiday experience.Know Before You GoA valid event ticket to Disney Jollywood Nights is required and is not included with your dining reservation.Food and beverages are available for purchase and are not included with your Disney Jollywood Nights event ticket.This event takes place at The Hollywood Brown Derby.Only the event-exclusive menu will be offered. The standard menu for The Hollywood Brown Derby will not be available during this event.Alcohol will only be served to Guests ages 21 and older with valid identification.Entertainment, offerings and experiences are subject to restrictions and change or cancellation without notice.
